Figure 1:Endpoint evaluation versus trajectory-aware measurement.Endpoint success conflates direct and circuitous successful trajectories and
assigns the same outcome to recoverable near-misses and irreversible failures.
DetourBench compares charged accesses with the full-information minimumLoL_{o}and computes residual workRTR_{T}from recoverable terminal states, separating
outcome, oracle-relative excess interaction, and residual-distance progress.

Figure 2:DetourBench transition semantics and evaluation pipeline.Agents interact with partially observable finite transition systems in which
discovered resource identifiers remain globally addressable. Exhaustive search
computes the full-information minimum charged accessesLoL_{o}and residual workRTR_{T}. Success, conditional attainment, residual progress, normalized detour,
redundant interaction, and irreversible failure are reported separately.
